title: LoveIsland
description: Minecraft Mod, where Mob's like you
body:
# LoveIsland

LoveIsland is a Fabric mod for Minecraft that you can access by creating a portal with crying obsidian. When you enter the game, you are greeted by "_lovers_".

![Loveisland.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e6c93a58fd07ceb2875cb66ecf633fed8adea41.png)
## How to Access

1. Any Crying Obsidian portal will unlock a new island. Ignite it using flint and steel.

2. The portal sends you to a new grasslands dimension, where guests are waiting for you and drop mixed loot.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: `1.15+` (tested)
